column1: P1.1 Project setup and first test
column2: Phase P1. Repo structure, test scripts, CI/CD, templates, and the two first tests (Tauri on both machines, claude -p Unverified facts). Done when: CI is green on macOS and Ubuntu, and DEC-01 is closed with measured numbers.

Phase P1. The empty desktop app: window, tray, navigation frame, design tokens, settings and themes. Done when: every sidebar item opens a screen on Mac and Ubuntu, and closing the window keeps Mnemo in the tray.

Phase P1. One SQLite file behind one storage module, with migrations, export, backup and reset. Done when: 100 parallel writes lose nothing and each item type has add, read, list, update, delete with tests.

Phase P1. Run claude -p per task on the Claude subscription, with a queue, a fake runner for tests, the AI switch and usage control. Done when: a test prompt answers through claude -p on Mac and Ubuntu and the app still works with AI off.

Phase P2. Save links with summary and tags, folders, the Bookmarks page, duplicate check, import, and the eval for save quality. Done when: real links are saved for one week and the eval has a first baseline score.
Phase P2. The Everything list with word search and tags, and Ask Mnemo with sources. Done when: 15 real questions get an answer with a real source and 3 trick questions get "nothing found".
Phase P3. Markdown notes with nested labels, ideas with stages, and the notes AI actions. Done when: a note becomes an idea and both survive a restart.
Phase P3. Project list, project page with blocks, kanban and card detail. Done when: one real project runs from idea to done inside the app.
Phase P3. Tasks, calendar, goals and the Today page without connectors. Done when: Today shows real tasks, events and unread items, and each button opens the right item.

Phase P4. Read Slack, Gmail and Calendar through Claude Code connectors (read-only), show the day summary, and send a daily report to the owner only. Done when: Today shows a real Slack and Gmail summary and a daily report reaches the owner. Version 1 ends here.
Manual checks by the owner at the end of each version 1 phase (P1 to P4), on Mac and Ubuntu. One ticket per phase.

Phase P5, after version 1. Scheduled jobs, approval inbox, memory, quiet notifications, digests and MCP settings. Done when: a daily digest runs by itself for one week, stops at the usage limit and never acts without approval. Tickets are short and get split when the phase starts.

Phase P6, after version 1. Link research, deep research, About me, the graph for AI agents, trending and learning paths. Done when: one saved link goes through research to an idea and a project, with two approvals. Tickets are short and get split when the phase starts.
Phase P7, after version 1. Features marked Later, and extra life features. Each one is independent and has its own check.
Phase P8. API key mode, own tokens, phone. These come after everything else.
